llm.summary: This is a coherent daily reading skill that stores only reading progress and does not show hidden credential access, exfiltration, or destructive behavior.

dimensions.detail: The declared purpose is progressive reading of bundled 大唐西域记 text with generated lectures, maps, optional art or voice, and progress tracking; the artifacts support that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The trigger list includes broad terms such as xuanzang and 西域记, which could cause accidental activation, but the resulting actions are limited to content generation and reading-progress updates.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains markdown, bundled text, metadata, and a Python progress helper; no install hooks, dependency installs, background setup, or privileged commands were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Local file access is limited to bundled volume files and a disclosed progress file under ~/.openclaw/workspace/daily-xuanzang; optional image, voice, scheduling, or Telegram delivery are described as user-configured integrations.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill persists language preference, cursor, and history in a disclosed progress.json and provides status, set, reset, and set-lang commands; this is proportionate but users should know advancement changes saved state.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with the skill saving reading progress locally and advancing that progress after an episode is delivered. Use explicit trigger phrases like “daily xuanzang” or “继续读西域记” to avoid accidental activation, and review any optional scheduling, image, voice, or Telegram delivery setup before enabling it.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: Broad trigger phrases are a real UX risk for accidental invocation, but the artifact does not pair them with sensitive access, credential use, destructive actions, or hidden automation.
[SQP-2] expected: Persistent progress tracking is central to the skill and is disclosed in SKILL.md and README.md, including the storage path and reset/status controls, so it does not warrant Review by itself.
[staticScan] expected: Static scan reported clean and local inspection found no suspicious command execution, network fetching code, or privileged install behavior.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry was clean, with no malicious or suspicious engine detections.
